tools.name: search_tests
tools.description: A/B tests ABWatcher caught on brands' public pages, newest first, each with what changed, the surface, the testing tool found and a link. Filter by brand, surface, page type or testing tool.

tools.name: get_test
tools.description: One A/B test by id: what changed, the likely hypothesis, the takeaway, the testing tools found and links to both screenshots.

tools.name: search_brands
tools.description: Brands ABWatcher watches, most detected tests first. Filter by name or domain and by industry.

tools.name: get_brand
tools.description: One brand by domain: its tags, the testing tools found on its pages (Optimizely, VWO, Adobe Target...) and its recent A/B tests.

tools.name: who_uses_tool
tools.description: Brands where ABWatcher found this A/B testing tool on their pages.

tools.name: list_plays
tools.description: Conversion plays caught on brands' pages (social proof, urgency, calculators, signup flows...), rarest first, each with the brand and the evidence.
